name: Subsidy for Bio-floc Technology based Intensive Shrimp & Fish Farming
eligibility_facts: brackish-water beneficiaries need relevant CAA licence
hard_exclusions: minimum 2 and maximum 6 tanks for stated special package
questions: Do you want fish/shrimp farming using bio-floc technology?
How many tanks are you planning?
Is it freshwater or brackish water?
temporal_note: Source labels the underlying scheme as 2020-21; verify current availability before surfacing.

question.en: Are you an interested farmer, hatchery operator, private entrepreneur, or unemployed youth seeking an eligible Bio-floc activity?
question.or: ଆପଣ ଯୋଗ୍ୟ ବାୟୋ-ଫ୍ଲକ୍ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ପାଇଁ ଆଗ୍ରହୀ ଚାଷୀ, ହ୍ୟାଚେରୀ ପରିଚାଳକ, ବେସରକାରୀ ଉଦ୍ୟୋଗୀ କିମ୍ବା ବେକାର ଯୁବକ/ଯୁବତୀ କି?

eligibilityCriteria.source_text: brackish-water beneficiaries need relevant CAA licence

description.en: For a brackish-water project, the relevant Coastal Aquaculture Authority licence must be confirmed separately.
description.or: ଲୁଣିଆ ପାଣି ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପ ପାଇଁ ସମ୍ପୃକ୍ତ Coastal Aquaculture Authority ଲାଇସେନ୍ସକୁ ଅଲଗା ଭାବେ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରିବାକୁ ପଡ଼ିବ।

description.en: The proposed Bio-floc tanks and system design must be verified against the scheme specifications.
description.or: ପ୍ରସ୍ତାବିତ ବାୟୋ-ଫ୍ଲକ୍ ଟ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଏବଂ ସିଷ୍ଟମ୍ ଡିଜାଇନ୍‌କୁ ଯୋଜନାର ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶନାମା ସହ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରିବାକୁ ପଡ଼ିବ।

eligibilityCriteria.source_text: [EXCLUSION] minimum 2 and maximum 6 tanks for stated special package

question.en: How many tanks are proposed for the special-package project?
question.or: ବିଶେଷ ପ୍ୟାକେଜ୍ ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପ ପାଇଁ କେତେଟି ଟ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ପ୍ରସ୍ତାବିତ?
